target: Runtime<MemoryStore> retention policy, generated append, floor, expiry, cleanup, and read_after
evidence_scope: Production Runtime and MemoryStore retention APIs with bounded deterministic input. This verifies logical floor/expiry behavior and bounded in-memory cleanup; SQLite persistence and fault qualification remain separate.

result.summary: The production Memory runtime kept retry identity and replay history as separate, explicit horizons.

observations.label: Retry horizon
observations.expected: generation-one retry survives floor movement, then expires explicitly

observations.label: Bounded cleanup
observations.expected: finite turns complete with at most one event row, one retry row, and 1 MiB per turn
